about: Mods that are known not to work together, and mods that need another mod without saying so in their metadata. Every entry names where it was established: a maintainer's answer, or a case replayed in the lab (lab/corpus). Mod ids were read from the published jars, not guessed.

incompatible.why: Jade's author says the two do not work together: Not Enough Crashes catches the loading entrypoints Jade registers into.

needs.why: LitematicaTool does not declare Litematica, so the loader lets it through and the game fails later while building the creative tabs.
